reviewed_boundary: accepted G4 matched causal runtime contract + target-executed G7 shared-outcome candidate -> proposed G8 independent reentry evidence binder -> semantic GWT/J-Space admission discriminator

finding.observation: The proposed G8 claim says the shared REENTRY_OBSERVED predicate should be derived from canonical observation payloads whose hashes equal the G4-bound runtime_witness_sha256/control_readback_sha256. However the current G4 ControlNoBroadcastReadback.observe(...) API receives reentry_observed as a caller-supplied argument, and ControlNoBroadcastReadback.__post_init__ rejects any true value. Therefore the serialized control readback contains reentry_observed=false by construction of the no-broadcast arm, not because an independent downstream observer derived absence of re-entry from raw behavior. Re-reading and hash-binding that value in G8 would preserve provenance but would not remove the semantic circularity.
finding.why_hash_binding_is_insufficient: Exact SHA-256 binding can prove that G8 consumed the same G4 control readback, but it cannot transform a condition-constrained assertion inside that readback into an independently observed semantic outcome. Identity/provenance exactness and observational independence are separate requirements.

required_discriminator.name: CONDITION_BLIND_DOWNSTREAM_REENTRY_OBSERVER
required_discriminator.rule: The semantic outcome must be derived from raw downstream observation records by code that does not receive the arm condition as an outcome input. Intervention/control labels may be bound only after the observer has emitted and hashed its result.
minimum_observables: raw downstream event/readback bytes or immutable event-record digests
explicit UNKNOWN when the observation window or event coverage is insufficient
required_discriminator.acceptable_shape: For example, hash the raw downstream event stream first, then let one arm-agnostic observer derive REENTRY_OBSERVED from presence/absence of a concrete re-entry event within a bounded observation window. Only afterward bind that already-derived result to INTERVENTION_BROADCAST or CONTROL_NO_BROADCAST.
required_discriminator.forbidden_shape: Do not derive true/false from condition, from a class invariant that forbids one value for one arm, or from a payload field whose value was itself supplied by the arm constructor rather than independently observed.

candidate_regressions.expect: The same raw observer record yields the same derived semantic result regardless of whether the caller later labels it intervention or control; condition labels cannot change observer output.
A control receipt containing reentry_observed=false but lacking independently bound raw event/window evidence is rejected or classified UNKNOWN, not accepted as semantic absence.
An intervention-labelled arm whose raw observer trace contains no qualifying re-entry event derives false/UNKNOWN according to the predeclared observer contract; the label alone cannot force true.

A control-labelled arm whose raw observer trace contains a qualifying re-entry event must derive true and thereby falsify the assumed no-broadcast control invariant rather than being rejected merely because the class forbids true.
If the bounded observer cannot prove it watched the full declared post-input/re-entry window, absence of a re-entry event remains UNKNOWN rather than false.

next_exact_action: Active WP900 G8 owner should make the G8 binder condition-blind at the observation boundary and add the five adversarial regressions above before repository acceptance. If the existing G4 control payload cannot supply independent raw observation/window evidence, introduce only the smallest observer/readback needed to obtain it; do not relabel G4/G7 evidence as semantic GWT/J-Space credit.
